body:
Found while working the backlog top-down (Emily Way Principle 1, lowest-numbered open section): S153-14 (opened 2026-07-19) describes the exact same entity-graph/signalapi/newssite full-in-memory-replay fragility that SECTION 1's top-priority item already fully resolved via Phases 0-3 (streaming eventstore.Scan API, Apple #9989; SQLite checkpoints for signalapi Apple #10207 and newssite Apple #10209; entity-graph checkpoint enabling the previously-disabled service, Apple #10503) -- same symptom (AMZN 'we don't cover' during rebuild), same three processes, same root cause. S153-14 was simply never marked done because the fix landed under a different, earlier section rather than being cross-referenced back. No new code -- documentation correction only, marking the checkbox true to match already-shipped/verified reality (same pattern as this backlog's own S23-01/S154-01 stale-checkbox corrections).

⚓ ☃
title: S153-14 stale-checkbox correction: already fixed by SECTION 1 replay-fragility work
